name: Avoided BAU (sludge AD)
notes:
This pathway is used for "Latic acid production from sludge via arrested anaerobic digestion." The energy use and emissions of this pathway are considered to be avoided by diverting waste from conventional waste management practice. In this case, anaerobic digestion of wastewater sludge is avoided.

Publication (forthcoming): Uisung Lee, Arpit Bhatt, Troy Robert Hawkins, Ling Tao, Pahola Thathiana Benavides, Michael Wang. "Life-cycle analysis of renewable natural gas and lactic acid production from waste feedstocks" 2020

AD residue (digestate) is one of the outputs of the latic acid production. To account for transporting AD residue, we have added relevant processes.
